auth-cancelled: The authorization was cancelled or timed out, so no token was obtained.
auth-token-failed: The server did not hand over a token. Check the endpoint and the credentials of the client.
fs-read: Mandor could not read the requested file.
fs-write: Mandor could not save the requested file.
git-failed: The operation could not be completed.
git-missing: A tool Mandor needs is not installed on this machine.
git-not-a-repo: The chosen folder does not hold an Mandor workspace.
import-format-unknown: Mandor does not read this file: it is not in a format this app imports.
import-other-app: This workspace file was written by the other Mandor app. Open it there.
format-newer: This was saved by a newer version of Mandor. Update the app to open it.
graphql-introspection: The server did not hand over its schema. Check that it serves GraphQL and allows introspection.
snippet-failed: Mandor could not write the request as code.
conflict-open: Some points still have no choice, so nothing was changed.
name-taken: That name is already taken here, so nothing was moved.
not-found: That is not there anymore, so nothing was written.
origin-foreign: That address holds content that does not belong to Mandor, so nothing was brought.
origin-unreachable: That address did not answer. Check it and try again.
record-active: This connection is already recording. Stop that recording before starting another.
request-aborted: The request was cancelled before it finished.
request-failed: The request could not be sent.
request-file: A file the request names could not be read from this workspace.
request-http-version: The server does not speak the HTTP version this request is held to.
request-redirect: The server redirected the request somewhere Mandor will not follow.
request-timeout: The server did not answer in time.
request-tls: The secure connection could not be verified. Check the certificate.
request-unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check the address and your network.
script-failed: A script failed, so nothing went out. The console says which one and why.
unknown: Mandor could not complete the operation.
ws-open-cancelled: The connection was not opened: it was closed or opened again while its script ran.
ws-open-failed: The connection could not be opened.
ws-open-unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check the address and your network.
ws-open-tls: The secure connection could not be verified. Check the certificate.
ws-open-timeout: The server did not answer in time.
ws-open-rejected: The server refused the connection. Check the address, the headers and the authentication.
ws-connection-lost: The connection to the server was lost.
ws-send-failed: The message could not be sent because the socket is not open.
network-file: A certificate file of the network settings could not be read. Pick it again.
network-proxy: Mandor cannot go through this proxy. Requests speak HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS5; connections also SOCKS4.
request-too-large: The response is larger than the limit this request allows.
